provenance: measured in MuJoCo (no servo datasheet available)
method: per joint: saturate actuator force from rest at each of 65 configurations (1 home + 64 uniform-random, seed 0), both signs; q_dot_max = worst-case peak velocity over 3.0s, q_ddot_max = worst-case |qacc| at t=0
caveat: inherits damping=2 / armature=0.1 from the MJCF, which are CAD placeholders, not measured -- re-run after sim-to-real system ID (H6)
